claim: Cross-AZ ENA Express is enabled by default on all newly created Multi-AZ DB instances that use eligible instance classes; to enable it on an existing Multi-AZ DB instance, stop and start the instance, modify it to use an eligible instance class, or use Scale Compute on an eligible instance class.

evidence.quote: Cross-Availability Zone ENA Express is enabled by default on all newly created Multi-AZ DB instances that use eligible instance classes.
To enable Cross-Availability Zone ENA Express on an existing Multi-AZ DB instance, do one of the following:
Stop and start the DB instance.
Modify the DB instance to use an eligible instance class.
Use Scale Compute on an eligible instance class.
